name: Atari 800XL
credits: Layout after the Atari 800XL (1983) keyboard; colours after its beige case, black caps and light console keys.
notes: Faithful: the XL key matrix with black caps and white upper-case legends on the beige case, the shifted, CLEAR, INSERT, DELETE and cursor-arrow legends above the characters, CAPS beside *, the INVERSE key after the right SHIFT, and RESET, OPTION, SELECT, START and HELP as the light column on the right, one to a row. BREAK ends the number row beside BACK S, where it sits on the XL. Letters type lower case and SHIFT upper case; CAPS locks capitals. Approximated: widths are compressed to fit a phone, there is no gap before the console keys, the space bar is drawn long so HELP can sit in its column (a row cannot hold a gap), the inverse key is the text INVERSE (no logo), shifted < and > type < and >, and the aluminium strip above the keys is not drawn, since a skin has no decorative elements. Mapped to none: BREAK, TAB, CTRL, INVERSE and the console keys. The cursor arrows on - = + * were CTRL combinations and are out of scope.
